predict_speech_to_text: predict text transcription from an audio file path or tensor using the S2THubInterface model
get_model_input_preprocess_audio: preprocess audio into fbank features or standardized waveform tensors for the speech-to-text model
detokenize_tokens_to_text: detokenize model output tokens into human-readable text using the task's BPE tokenizer and target dictionary
get_prediction_with_tts: generate speech-to-text predictions with optional text-to-speech synthesis using a configured TTS model
get_prefix_token_lang_tag: get the language tag prefix token for a target language to prepend to generation input
